name: defect-to-pr
description: Take a defect report through reproduce → fix-and-verify loop → human-gated review. The loop re-runs the fix until QA reports [VERIFIED] or the cap is hit.

phases.name: reproduce
phases.description: Reproduce the defect; produce a failing-case description the fix loop can verify against.

phases.name: fix-and-verify
phases.description: Refine the fix until QA verifies it; at most 4 attempts.

phases.name: review
phases.description: Lead reviews the verified fix before it becomes a PR.
